title: Great start to coding
text: I spent a lot of time trying to find a coding class for my 9 year old. Due to COVID I wasn’t happy with an in person set up, and we had already tried virtual, which is basically an instructor telling you what to drag and drop where. With Bitsbox my child can code at her own pace, on her schedule, and it is a fraction of what I would pay for a coding class.
label: positive
